description: Pre-modernization unit-test baseline (JDK 17). Per-module surefire/failsafe counts parsed from target/*-reports/TEST-*.xml. Compare with compare_baseline.py.

notes: Single-module build (aai-resources) on JDK 17.0.20.1, parent org.onap.aai.aai-common:aai-parent:1.18.0 from the ONAP Nexus. The one error (K6ReadTest.readWithoutRelationsTest) needs a Docker daemon ("Could not find a valid Docker environment") and fails in the sandbox before any code change; the 2 skipped tests are @Ignore/@Disabled in the sources.

Not buildable on JDK 17: the parent chain org.onap.policy.parent:integration:6.1.0-SNAPSHOT -> policy-parent:6.1.0-SNAPSHOT (resolved from the ONAP snapshot repository) sets maven.compiler.release=21, so api-main fails with "release version 21 not supported". The JDK 17 attempt is kept under prior_attempts.

Counts below were therefore recorded on JDK 21.0.12.1 (the only JDK that can build this repo); policy-api is already a Java 21 project and its SNAPSHOT parent/dependencies (policy-common 4.1.0-SNAPSHOT, policy-models 5.1.0-SNAPSHOT) are moving targets, so these numbers can drift when upstream republishes.

prior_attempts.reason: compiler error 'release version 21 not supported': the build requires a newer JDK than the one used (Java release set by the parent POM / dependencies)

environment_exclusions.expected_follow_up: a later milestone replaces cassandra-unit with Testcontainers; remove this entry when the classes run again
environment_exclusions.symptom: the surefire fork never finishes: embedded Cassandra blocks forever in CommitLog segment allocation; each class was verified individually (JDK 17.0.20.1, serial) and was killed by -Dsurefire.timeout=90 with 'There was a timeout or other error in the fork' and 0 reports

notes: Baseline collected on JDK 17.0.20.1 with the sdc default -T2 and surefire forkCount=1C; all 161 reactor modules plus catalog-fe built (exit 0); failsafe ITs (Docker/Testcontainers) are not part of it.

catalog-dao: CassandraClientTest, SdcSchemaBuilderTest and SdcSchemaUtilsTest (cassandra-unit EmbeddedCassandra) hang forever in this sandbox; they are excluded via -Dsurefire.excludesFile and listed under environment_exclusions, not counted in the module numbers.

Attribution of the 229 errors: 219 = JanusGraph in-memory "PermanentLockingException ... mismatched timestamps" while building the Spring/Janus context (catalog-model 156, catalog-dao 32 = JanusGraphGenericDaoTest 10 + JanusGraphDaoTest 22, catalog-be 31 = ExternalRefsServletTest 18 + ArchiveEndpointTest 9 + ForwardingPath tests 4); reproduced serially and also on JDK 21.0.12.1, so sandbox/environment, not parallelism and not the JDK.

10 errors = JDK 17 strong encapsulation (InaccessibleObjectException: common-app-api SerializationUtilsTest 6 via java.math.BigDecimal, catalog-be gson PropertyConvertorTest/PropertyConstraintsUtilsTest 4 via java.util.regex.Pattern); they need --add-opens or a code change.

The 11 failures are plain assertion failures unrelated to JDK or environment: vendor-license-rest-types 4 and vendor-license-api 4 (bean getter/setter checks), asdctool GraphMLConverterTest 2, security-util CipherUtilTest 1.
The build rewrites the tracked file asdctool/sdc-cassandra-init/version.sh (1.16.1 -> 1.19.0); restore it with git checkout after a baseline run.
